authority: CLAUDE.md §12.3; operator rulings of 2026-08-28 (fieldwise-run-02-baseline_2026-08-28.json), applying the newest-agreed-position principle: the Consolidated Partner Review Pack of 2026-08-28 is the latest partner-reviewed position and prevails over earlier operator answers where they conflict.
title: Supersessions bundled with the ATK baseline: placement arrangement, placement-supervisor title, placement IP parties, teaching route, ethics/DPO anchoring, MVCRI in-action seat

supersessions.prior: Declaration placement_workspace_AgroVIR (2026-08-14): desk or office at AgroVIR for M25-M30, access to the FMIS development and staging environment, access to the customer-data environment.
supersessions.new: Declaration placement_arrangement_AgroVIR (2026-08-28): mainly remote collaboration with monthly face-to-face technical meetings; no direct access to proprietary software, customer databases, office infrastructure or computing equipment required; protected, coded or anonymised extracts (the 'Field X' pattern) supplied for interoperability testing.
supersessions.why_new_prevails: Pack §2.1/§3.2 and DI line 102 state the remote arrangement expressly and it is the partner-reviewed position; the pack's risk R09 is built on it ('unrestricted customer-system access is not a project dependency'). The old workspace declaration is withdrawn, not amended.
supersessions.conflict_note: decision_inputs_2026-08.md also carries the old workspace text (line 97) — an internal contradiction inside the input file. Resolved for the Pack reading because the Pack is dated 2026-08-28, is the curated partner-review document, and its §2.1 sentence explicitly negates the access list.

supersessions.why_new_prevails: Both sources of the new baseline name him Managing Director; the supervision argument now leans on his managing-director experience in agricultural digitalisation and FMIS rather than on a research grade. Remains Assumed pending AgroVIR's written confirmation of the supervision arrangement.

supersessions.prior: placement_ip_ownership (2026-08-15, Option C): results vest in ELTE as beneficiary; agreement between the fellow, ELTE and AgroVIR.
supersessions.new: Results vest in HUN-REN ATK as beneficiary by the same grant default; agreement between the fellow, HUN-REN ATK and AgroVIR, concluded before the placement begins.
supersessions.why_new_prevails: Mechanical re-anchoring under the host switch, stated in the canonical open-decisions document ('the parties become the fellow, HUN-REN ATK and AgroVIR, and results vest in the new beneficiary by the grant default'). The allocation logic of Option C is unchanged.

supersessions.prior: Co-design and delivery of a full module unit within an ELTE MSc course on Earth observation for agriculture; co-supervision of the field-experiment component of one PhD student's work.
supersessions.new: Short guest lectures, seminars or practical sessions at MATE and, where institutionally possible, the Agricultural University of Plovdiv, linking plant-stress physiology with UAV/EO monitoring, precision agriculture and agricultural data science.
supersessions.why_new_prevails: The ELTE measures fell with the university host: ATK is a research organisation and ELTE is now an associated partner whose commitments are evidence-grade declarations. The Pack §1.3 states the new route explicitly and grounds it in the fellow's five years of teaching and the Bulgarian-Hungarian academic links.

supersessions.prior: Item 3 (2026-08-11): ELTE research ethics committee consulted on the human-feedback task; ELTE Data Protection Officer consulted before the first MVP user account.
supersessions.new: The HUN-REN ATK research-ethics route and the competent HUN-REN/ATK DPO function, same triggers and timing (committee consultation before fieldwork, written position by M12; DPO before the first user account). The function is named until ATK's written confirmation names the body.
supersessions.why_new_prevails: The canonical open-decisions document lists this re-anchoring as a consequential change of the switch. The ethics substance (GDPR-limited personal data, commercial farmer data, low-risk human feedback, no animals/dual-use/non-EU transfer, ethics_issues_identified = true) is unchanged.

supersessions.prior: TRANSFER_PARTNER with the WP4 Bulgarian trial ('MATE -> MVCRI'), 1.5 PM in-kind effort, a Steering Group seat, and KPIs K5/K6 reported to its contact.
supersessions.new: Post-MSCA replication and transferability route on no WP month line; no in-action effort; no Steering Group seat; the record retained for narrative traceability and the fellow's employer-of-record disclosure.
supersessions.why_new_prevails: Pack §3.2 and Appendix C item 9 state the re-scoping and its reason (protect 24-month feasibility while preserving a credible replication route). The person_months_MVCRI declaration is removed; contact_email_MVCRI and the signatory placeholder are retained for the post-MSCA route.
